einzeiler: A mother faces an impossible choice after her fiancé is accused of abusing her child.
kurzfassung: Days after her engagement, Cindy discovers her fiancé has been accused of abusing one of her children. Finding that the facts do not add up, she must choose between her child and what she believes is the truth. This introduces the upcoming third season of the podcast.
stichpunkte: Engagement shortly before an abuse accusation emerges
Accusation involving one of Cindy's children
Discrepancies found in the facts behind the allegation
Family division resulting from the accusation
Introduction to the third season of Burden of Guilt
beschreibung:
Just five days after her engagement to Kenny, Cindy learns that her fiancé was accused of abusing one of Cindy’s children. The facts behind the accusation didn’t add up to Cindy. As the allegation tore her family apart, Cindy faced an impossible choice: stand by her child or stand by what she believed to be the truth.   A brand new season of Burden of Guilt begins July 29th.
You can reach out to the Burden of Guilt team at Burdenofguiltpod@gmail.com. For more Burden of Guilt, follow us on Instagram @glasspodcasts.
